title: docs(spec): clarify has index guard
body:
Fixes #25282

Clarifies that terminal indexes are refused by has(), while intermediate numeric segments remain unguarded because the guard builder emits named field selections only.

Validation:
- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build
- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated
- pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test -- flow-value-slot-template.test.ts
